verdict.rationale: cubic runs event-triggered agents: it automatically reviews every new PR and auto-approves low-risk ones, and it keeps an exported wiki current through a rolling pull request. Fixing is user-initiated (one click per finding), and codebase scans have no documented schedule, so it is not an always-on autonomous maintainer. missing for 10: scheduled/recurring agent runs, autonomous trigger-based fixing without a user click, configurable custom triggers, independent corroboration of autonomous operation

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can set up always-on agents that run on schedules or triggers to maintain and fix my software autonomously

citations.quote: cubic automatically starts reviewing new pull requests in your selected repositories.
keeps them current through a rolling pull request
cubic can automatically fix issues identified during code review. Request a targeted fix with one click.
Auto-approval lets you skip human review for pull requests that cubic determines are low risk and issue-free.
